title: Privacy Assessment

area_notes.minimization: DEFECT-FOUND-AND-FIXED: WorkflowPrivacyPolicy.strict shipped an empty allowlist behind an isNotEmpty guard, so the strictest policy performed zero minimization.
area_notes.destinations: MEASURED-ENFORCED: an empty destination allowlist denies the request.
area_notes.content_exclusion: DEFECT-FOUND-AND-FIXED: ArchiveSecretPolicy.isSecretPath allowed .git/config and sub/.git/config; git remote URLs can embed credentials in plain text. Export-path evidence is folded into this axis, not a ninth axis.
area_notes.retention: MEASURED-ENFORCED: a non-positive retention window is rejected.
area_notes.deletion: UNMET, REPORTED-NOT-WAIVED: the surface offers unlink only, with no irreversible delete operation. Recorded as an open item, never claimed as satisfied.
area_notes.disconnect: MEASURED-ENFORCED: AccountDisconnectResult cannot report providerRevoked without providerRevokeAttempted.
area_notes.telemetry_controls: MEASURED-ENFORCED: telemetry surface aggregates safely and is surfaced as a control.

gate_harness_defect_fixed.what: classifyDataKind defaulted unrecognised names to operational, so any data kind could be walked by typing a new one.
gate_harness_defect_fixed.fix: unknown data kinds now classify as unknown.

verification.regression: 450 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed across test/workflow, test/features/project_resilience, test/core/observability, test/features/intent
verification.analyzer: No issues found! on all 4 slice files, exit 0
verification.necessity: NECESSITY_ALL_OK, 2/2 fixes load-bearing (rc=1 with 3 and 4 failing tests), byte-identical restores via SHA-256
verification.line_endings: a Python restore in the necessity drill converted two files to CRLF; both were detected by SHA-256 mismatch and normalized back to the committed LF form before commit

project.sqlite is not excluded by ArchiveSecretPolicy; whether the export contract requires excluding the project database is unreconciled and was not widened in this slice.
